concept.title: People in financial need
concept.shortdesc: People and households struggling with money, debt or the cost of living, or needing emergency food and other basic support.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : People or households struggling with money, debt, the cost of living or a sudden loss of income.
: People in need, mainly those referred to or using a food bank or needing emergency food, plus generic wording about people or families in need.
